title: Baanzon Verso built-in AI, zero-config gateway fallback, and cross-platform hardening
highlights: OmniRoute is now Baanzon Verso: the built-in AI ships vendored with auto-install and a self-heal supervisor
A local AI gateway provides a zero-config fallback when no provider is configured
Full Windows support is verified: the app-core suite passes 987/987 on Windows
improvements: GUI sessions launch and reload reliably across platforms
Subprocess tool calls use arg-based invocation and panel toggles are fixed in the TUI
fixes: Gateway pairing and CORS are hardened
Provider runtime edge cases are fixed
GUI backend blocks path traversal and restricts shell permissions
Session IDs are sanitized and Cursor auth is isolated per session
Windows compile blockers are resolved so the release builds and passes its suite
